Name: Stardew Craftable Tackle
Author: blueOstrich
Description:
The lead bobber and curiosity lure recipes are unlockable.

Requirements: 

[b]Lead bobber:
[/b][spoiler]
You will receive a recipe in the mail for the lead bobber upon completing the Mother Catch achievement--catch 100 fish. 
Crafting a lead bobber costs 1 iron bar and 10 stone. 
[/spoiler]

[b]Curiosity lure[/b]: 
[spoiler]
You will receive a recipe in the mail for the curiosity lure upon completing the Master Angler achievement--catch every fish. 
Crafting a curiosity lure costs 1 gold bar and 1 ruby. 
[/spoiler]

Downloads.Description: Adds craft recipes for the lead bobber and curiosity lure
